basis: Owner confirms removable end nut, requests less generous adjustment slots and tabbed deeper repair form. Strong R006 planar calipers and unchanged primary capture remain separate evidence.

locators.offset_basis: Design-selected rounded offsets accommodate captured shaft paths at the new sheet plane. They are not corrections to measured factory holes.
locators.purpose: Loose alignment aid before visual centering and supported retention. No bend, preload, extra clamp or gasket movement intended.
locators.installation_state: Remove end nuts first; their captured enlarged envelopes do not pass these smaller slots. Preserve factory reassembly order and engagement.

form.rear_relief_basis: Practical rounded clearance windows around the captured left-side and lower-body conflicts; explicit working geometry, not a certified scan-error allowance.
form.locator_role: Integral front-side loose tabs, outside the casting zone. No new rear fasteners or embedded locating tabs.
form.support: Same independently braced temporary face concept as RF01; rods locate only and must not carry repair loads.
form.use: Temporary form for the same bounded front repair; the longer relieved skirt is not a 24 mm continuous casting wall. Remove tool, liner and pads after the selected repair permits stripping. Permanent retained use is not established.
